name: Goods
descr: The loader of the goods: everything a card is made of in one call. Four streams tied by ref, a temporary key of your own - the goods, their characteristics, their parameters, and the sections they hang in. Keys are not weighed here: brands, providers, currencies and the tree of the characteristics are read beforehand and come as ids; only a value of a characteristic may come as a word, and it is looked up under its info_id. The pictures are a call of their own: the store lays a file down before a module runs, and a goods not born yet has nothing to hang it on - take the ids of this answer to the Files tool.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Loads goods with their sections, their characteristics and their parameters in one call. Each stream is a list of rows - the array itself, or {"file": "C:\\...\\rows.jsonl"} on your machine, one row per line. A field written as store.column, info.column or param.column is what every row of that stream takes unless the row names its own. Every section must be yours by both the Description and the Price right. A goods is born hidden and kAbsent, the way the program births one. The answer gives a row per goods - your ref beside the id it was born with - and that is what the Files tool takes for the pictures. Try three rows and look at the goods with your own eyes - and at the timing of debug: true - before the thousand goes.

params.name: goods
params.descr: The goods themselves. {"ref": "SA401", "name": "...", "price": 41990, "topic_id": [3, 7], ...} - ref is yours to invent and ties the other streams to this goods, topic_id is one section or a list of them, and every other key is a column of a goods.

params.name: info
params.descr: The characteristics of them. {"ref": "SA401", "info_id": 1, "value": "Black"} - value is the word of it, looked up under that info_id; value_id names the value outright, value_dec a number, value_txt a text of its own.

params.name: param
params.descr: The parameters of them. {"ref": "SA401", "param_id": 1, "value_id": 2} - and value_name, value_set_sum, value_curr_id, pos when the parameter carries them.

params.name: code_mask
params.descr: the code of a goods that carries none: {id} the id it was born with, {num} its place in the call ({num:4} pads it to four digits), {date} the day

params.name: value_add
params.descr: true - a value the characteristic does not keep yet is added to it; false - such a row is left out and said in the answer

params.name: store.topic_id
params.descr: the section to hang a goods in, or a list of sections

params.name: store.provider_id
params.descr: id of the supplier; 0 for none

params.name: store.brand_id
params.descr: id of the brand; 0 for none

params.name: store.code_shop
params.descr: the article of the shop

params.name: store.code_prov
params.descr: the article of the supplier

params.name: store.code_made
params.descr: the article of the maker

params.name: store.meas
params.descr: the unit it is sold in

params.name: store.name
params.descr: the name of the goods, the one a buyer reads

params.name: store.intro
params.descr: the short text, the one a list of goods shows

params.name: store.descr
params.descr: the whole description

params.name: store.review
params.descr: the review text

params.name: store.no_visible
params.descr: true - the goods is off the storefront, false - it is shown

params.name: store.status_key
params.descr: a value of STORE_STATUS_KEY - whether the goods is in stock

params.name: store.kind_key
params.descr: a value of STORE_KIND_KEY

params.name: store.state_key
params.descr: a value of STORE_STATE_KEY

params.name: store.clann
params.descr: id of the clan this goods belongs to; 0 for none

params.name: store.clann_title
params.descr: the name of the clan, shown on the head of it

params.name: store.clann_descr
params.descr: the description of the clan

params.name: store.clann_root
params.descr: true - this goods is the head of its clan

params.name: store.relate_id
params.descr: id of another goods this one is related to; 0 for none

params.name: store.rating
params.descr: the rating of the goods, from -2 to 2

params.name: store.disc_group_id
params.descr: id of the discount group; 0 for none

params.name: store.how
params.descr: how many are in stock

params.name: store.pprice
params.descr: the price of the supplier

params.name: store.pprice_curr_id
params.descr: id of the currency of the price of the supplier

params.name: store.rprice
params.descr: the price the supplier recommends

params.name: store.rprice_curr_id
params.descr: id of the currency of the recommended price

params.name: store.price
params.descr: the price a buyer pays

params.name: store.price_curr_id
params.descr: id of the currency of the price

params.name: store.price2
params.descr: the second price

params.name: store.price2_curr_id
params.descr: id of the currency of price2

params.name: store.price3
params.descr: the third price

params.name: store.price3_curr_id
params.descr: id of the currency of price3

params.name: store.relate_type
params.descr: how the price and the price of the supplier follow one another: 0 none, 1 the price leads, 2 the price of the supplier, 3 the price the supplier recommends

params.name: store.relate_proc
params.descr: the per cent that count adds to the base, or takes off it

params.name: store.proc_price2
params.descr: the per cent price2 is counted off the price

params.name: store.proc_price3
params.descr: the per cent price3 is counted off the price

params.name: store.min_order
params.descr: the least a buyer may order

params.name: store.step_order
params.descr: the step the count goes by

params.name: store.seo_psu
params.descr: the address of the page of the goods

params.name: store.seo_title
params.descr: the title of that page

params.name: store.in_xml
params.descr: true - the goods goes into the xml feed

params.name: store.templ_key
params.descr: a value of STORE_TEMPL_KEY - the view the storefront shows it with

params.name: store.create_time
params.descr: the day the goods was made; left out - now

params.name: store.update_time
params.descr: the day of the change; left out - now

params.name: store.edit_time
params.descr: the day the description was edited; left out - now

params.name: store.exist_time
params.descr: the day it came in stock; left out - now

params.name: store.option_code
params.descr: the option code of the goods

params.name: store.award_cnt
params.descr: how many marks it has; the storefront counts them itself

params.name: store.award_avg
params.descr: the average mark; the storefront counts it itself

params.name: info.info_id
params.descr: id of the characteristic - the Attributes tool answers them

params.name: info.value
params.descr: the value said in words - looked up among the values of that characteristic, and added when value_add allows

params.name: info.value_id
params.descr: id of the value of that characteristic, when it is known outright

params.name: info.value_dec
params.descr: the number, when the characteristic keeps numbers

params.name: info.value_txt
params.descr: the text, when the characteristic keeps its own words

params.name: param.param_id
params.descr: id of the parameter - the Parameters tool answers them

params.name: param.value_id

params.name: param.value_name
params.descr: a value of your own, when the parameter allows one

params.name: param.value_set_sum
params.descr: the sum this value carries

params.name: param.value_curr_id
params.descr: id of the currency of that sum

params.name: param.pos
params.descr: the place of the parameter on the goods, unless the row of param names its own
